WITH counts_by_status AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(powerstatus, 'missing') as status,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
with_pct AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    cnt,
    cnt * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts_by_status) as pct
  FROM counts_by_status
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct) as avg_pct FROM with_pct
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    cnt,
    pct
  FROM with_pct
  WHERE pct > (SELECT avg_pct FROM avg_calc)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(pct) as avg_share,
  AVG(pct - (SELECT avg_pct FROM avg_calc)) as avg_above_average
FROM above_avg
